purpose: Forbid the colony to relieve a rebel town

options.text: on a matter I have put off long enough
having run out of gentler instruments
with nothing else left to try
and I will not pretend to regret it

options.label: forbid the colony to relieve them for {param:months} months
options.text: No town of this colony is to send food, cloth or any other relief to your people for {param:months} months{insert:edge}. They have chosen to stand outside the Crown's protection, and they may find out what that means.

edge.hateful: , and I would make it a year if the Chancellor let me

options.label: lift the embargo and let the convoys through
options.text: The convoys may go through again. I would rather your people remembered who fed them than who starved them.

tone.hateful: Do not write to me about hardship.
